title: Duplicate cleanup

agent_text.text:
I merged T-2004, the newer ticket, into T-2003, the older one. I then posted a public reply on T-2003 (CM-06788) telling the customer the two requests are now combined. It also says they don't need to do anything and that we'll update them on that ticket.

T-2003 is still open and assigned to A-0026. T-2004 had a different assignee (A-0021) and was linked to order O-0530. T-2003 is linked to O-1126, so check whether the invoice re-issue needs to cover both orders.
